transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ____. What brings you in today?

My mom wanted me to come. Mostly I just... I can't really make myself do anything anymore. I just sit in my room all day with the same clothes on. I don't knit, or write in my journal, or go walking like I used to. And when my mom asks what's wrong, I just... I barely even have the energy to answer her.
Have you had episodes like this before?
No, I don't think so. I mean... I've never felt like this before. I used to be able to do things just fine, so... no. This is the first time it's been like this, where I just stop doing everything.
Have you ever had a period like this before?
No... um, like I just said, I haven't. It's never been like this before. This is the only time it's happened.
Have you been hearing or seeing things that other people don’t seem to notice?
No... I haven't noticed anything like that. I don't hear voices or see things that aren't there. Everything just looks and sounds normal to me.
Have you ever had a time like this that lasted at least two weeks before?
I... I feel like we just went over this. No. Not for two weeks, or... or even a few days. Like I said, I haven't ever had a time like this before now. This is the very first time.
Have you had any recent head injury, medical illness, or new neurological problem before this started?
No... um, I haven't hit my head or anything. And I haven't been sick, either. No new medical problems or... or anything like that. Physically, I've been completely fine.
In the past two weeks, have you been feeling depressed, sad, or down most of the day nearly every day?
No, I haven't. I mean... I guess I feel a little stressed out, but not really sad or down. Definitely not every day.
Have you felt depressed or down most days for at least the past two years?
No... definitely not. I haven't felt depressed for two years or anything like that. Like I said, I'm not really a sad person, so... no. I haven't felt down like that.
During this time, have you still been able to enjoy things when you do them?

Not really, because... mostly I just can't make myself do anything anymore. I just sit in my room with the same clothes on most days. I don't knit or write in my journal or go walking like I used to. Even when my mom asks me what's wrong, I just... I barely have the energy to answer her. So I'm not really doing anything to enjoy.
Have you felt depressed or sad most of the day, nearly every day, during this current period?
No, I... I think you already asked me that. Like I said before, I haven't been feeling sad or depressed every day. Just... empty, I guess. But not sad.
Have you lost or gained a noticeable amount of weight recently without trying?
No, I don't think so. I mean, I haven't really been paying much attention to that, but... my clothes still fit the same. So I haven't noticed any weight changes.
Have you been sleeping much more or much less than usual lately?
No, my sleep has been about the same. I just... I sleep my normal amount, I guess. I haven't noticed sleeping way more or way less or anything.
Have other people noticed that you’re moving or speaking more slowly than usual?
No, nobody has said anything like that to me. I... I think I'm moving and talking at my normal speed. At least, no one has pointed it out if I am.
Have you ever had a period where you felt unusually energized, needed much less sleep, or were much more talkative than usual?

No, not really. I don't think I've ever... I've never had a time where I felt super energized like that. I definitely haven't stopped needing sleep or started talking a whole bunch. It's just been pretty normal.
Over the past two years, have you felt down, depressed, or hopeless most days?
No, I wouldn't say that. I haven't felt down or depressed most days. I mean, I have normal days, but not like... not hopeless or anything like that for two years.
Has there been any other time in your life when you had these symptoms for at least two weeks?
No, I don't think so. I haven't really had anything like this happen before... at least not that I can remember. This is the first time I've dealt with anything like this.
During this current period, have you felt depressed or sad most of the day nearly every day?
No, I haven't. I don't really feel sad or depressed... just, you know, normal in that way. I haven't been feeling down all day or anything.
Have you had any thoughts that you’d be better off dead or of hurting yourself?
No, I haven't. I don't... I don't ever think about things like that. I definitely don't want to hurt myself or be dead.
Do you still enjoy things when you do them?

I don't really do much anymore to even know. Mostly I just... I can't make myself do anything. I just sit in my room with the same clothes on. I don't knit or journal or go walking like I used to. And when my mom comes in and asks what's wrong, I barely have the energy to even answer her.
Have there been any other times in your life when you felt this way for at least two weeks?
No, I don't think so. I mean, I can't really remember another time where it was like this, where I just... couldn't do anything for this long. This is the only time it's been this bad.
